topic: The Sun is a star not a living place like Earth
en: The Sun is different from Earth — the Sun is a star, a ball of burning gas, extremely hot, with no life that could live on it. Earth is a planet with solid ground, water, and air, so it has life. The Sun is not a planet, and Earth is not a star.
tl: Iba ang araw sa Earth — ang araw ay isang bituin na bola ng nag-aapoy na gas, sobrang init, at walang buhay na puwedeng tumira doon. Ang Earth naman ay isang planetang may matigas na lupa, tubig, at hangin kaya may buhay. Hindi planeta ang araw, at hindi bituin ang Earth.
